import sys

def is_better(num, den, bestNum, bestDen, x, y):
    if bestNum == -1:
        return True
    old_error = abs(bestNum * y - x * bestDen) * den
    candidate_error = abs(num * y - x * den) * bestDen
    return old_error > candidate_error

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    
    a = -1
    b = 0
    i = 1
    
    while i <= n:
        j = i * x // y
        if i * x - j * y > (j + 1) * y - i * x:
            j += 1
        
        if a == -1 or is_better(j, i, a, b, x, y):
            a = j
            b = i
        
        i += 1
    
    print(f"{a}/{b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
